name: Government Badge
description: Federal agent credentials. Shows you're official... for now.

spend_effect.message: You flash your badge. Authority recognized.

name: W-90 Handgun
description: Standard issue sidearm. 9mm, reliable, lethal.

name: Encrypted Codec
description: Secure radio. Channel 141.3 for handler. Others exist...

spend_effect.message: Codec active. Waiting for transmission...

name: Chen's Dropped Wallet
description: American dollars. Chinese Yuan. A photo of a panda from 1987. 'For Wei-Lin. Remember home.'

spend_effect.message: You examine the wallet. Chen was here. Not long ago.

name: Subway Token
description: Dirty. Bent. Used recently. Grants access to Underground Station.

spend_effect.message: The token fits. Turnstile opens.

name: Rusty Key
description: Old iron. No markings. The church archive key?

spend_effect.message: The key turns. The lock clicks.

name: Jesuit Bible
description: Latin text, 18th century printing. A hidden compartment reveals additional pages.

spend_effect.message: The hidden pages speak of 'children of the Middle Kingdom.'

name: Pinkerton Coin
description: Private eye. The insignia is unmistakable. Pinkertons are here.

spend_effect.message: You've found proof. They're not subtle.

name: Russian Matryoshka
description: Nesting doll. Russian. Open it — there's a note inside: 'Friend of friend. 142.7.'

spend_effect.message: A contact frequency. Someone wants to talk.

name: Vodka Flask
description: Real Russian vodka. Good for gifts. Or for courage.

spend_effect.message: You offer the flask. The dockside contact nods approvingly.

name: Panda Plushie
description: Cute. Chen was looking for this. Why?

spend_effect.message: You take the plushie. It feels heavier than it should.

name: Lab Coat
description: White coat. Faded logo: 'Hollow Creek Research Facility'.

spend_effect.message: The coat fits. You could pass for staff.

name: ID Badge (Dr. Hoffman)
description: Photo ID. Level 3 Access. Research Wing. Expired 2019.

spend_effect.message: The badge works. The guard doesn't check expiration dates.

name: Submarine Blueprint
description: Facility layout. Restricted areas marked. Something beneath the base.

spend_effect.message: They built a nuclear facility to hide something else.

name: Ventilation Key
description: Magnetic card. Opens maintenance shafts throughout the base.

spend_effect.message: The card activates a hidden panel.

name: Tattered Map
description: Part of a larger map. The cave system extends further than any official record shows.

spend_effect.message: The missing pieces connect to something called 'The Shrine'.

name: Magnifying Glass
description: Forensic tool. Useful for examining evidence.

spend_effect.message: Ready to analyze evidence.

name: 1987 Newspaper
description: Headline: 'Rare Pandas Arrive at Hollow Creek Zoo.' Date: October 1987.

spend_effect.message: Pandas arrived here. Same year Jesuits expanded the church.

name: Bamboo Plant
description: Living bamboo. The pandas were introduced to eat this. Or so the story goes.

spend_effect.message: The plant pulses with strange warmth.

name: Pinkerton Ledger
description: Financial records. Payments to 'Asset CW-7' since 1987. Recipient: Hollow Creek.

spend_effect.message: The Pinkertons have been paying Chen's family for decades.

name: Train Schedule
description: Midnight freight. Car 7 marked 'SPECIAL.' Unscheduled stops.

spend_effect.message: Something was extracted via train. Recently.

name: Chinese Calligraphy
description: Scroll reading: 'The bamboo remembers what men forget.'

spend_effect.message: A poem. Or a warning.

name: Family Photo
description: Chen with a woman and child. A daughter. On the back: 'Mei-Lin, age 7.'

spend_effect.message: Chen has a family. Someone knows this.

name: Security Tape
description: VHS tape labeled 'INTERVIEW 7.' Shows Chen with Augustus Pinkerton IV.

spend_effect.message: You watch Chen being threatened. The Pinkertons have leverage.

name: Organ Container
description: Glass cylinder, cryogenic fluid. Label: 'Panda Subject 7 — Liver. Recipient: Pinkerton IV.'

spend_effect.message: The pandas are not what they seem.

name: Research Notes
description: Specimen logs. Donor codes. 'Subject 47: Neural cluster, mature. Gift for Mr. Pinkerton's 89th birthday.'

spend_effect.message: Human stem cells. Opossum wombs. Pandas are chimeras.

name: Facility Keycard
description: Black card. No markings. 'LEVEL OMEGA' embossed in silver.

spend_effect.message: The final door. Beyond it, everything ends.

name: Satellite Uplink
description: Portable uplink. One transmission. Global reach.

spend_effect.message: Ready to transmit. Your finger hovers over the button.

name: Jesuit Ring
description: Iron ring, date 1415. 'Adiutorium Nostrum in Nomine Domini.' Inscribed: 'For when the Signet returns.'

spend_effect.message: Four hundred years of history on your finger.

name: Pinkerton Signet
description: Family seal. Used for six thousand years. The enemy you've been chasing.

spend_effect.message: Six thousand years of conflict. It ends here.
